description: Selected automated technical checks associated with migration to the NIST post-quantum standards (FIPS 203, 204 and 205).
legal_context: NIST has published the first post-quantum cryptography standards and plans to deprecate quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms. U.S. federal agencies are directed to inventory and migrate their cryptography, and the same timelines increasingly appear in customer and regulator expectations. Data encrypted today can be collected now and decrypted later.
